issues.display_title: Issue #257: feat(stitching): Update Stitcher Alin (pano.exe) to 2026-10-10 with Boundary Blending & Multi-Image Manifest
issues.main_description_html:
Demo

Summary

Update bundled Stitcher Alin binary (\pano.exe) to the latest 2026-10-10 engine build and expose new features across the Tauri backend and frontend UI.

Changes

  • Binary Engine Update:
    • Recompiled and bundled latest \pano.exe\ along with 6 C++ native extensions (including _boundary_native).
    • Verified standalone compatibility & handshake handling (7/7 tests passed).
  • Multi-Image (>4 photos) Manifest Support:
    • \stitching_alin.rs\ automatically writes \sources.json\ and uses --images-file\ when stitching >4 photos to prevent Windows 32K CLI character limit errors.
  • Boundary & Light Blending Integration:
    • Added --light-blending\ options (\�oundary, \�ngular,
      one) for Alin multiband rendering.
    • Added UI selector in Stitching Settings sidebar when Alin Multiband is selected.
    • Updated Redux state, IPC types, and i18n locales.

Testing & Verification

  • \cargo test --test test_pano_handshake: PASS (7/7)
  • \cargo test --test test_stitching_alin_external_blend: PASS (4/4)

  • ode --test src/.../stitchingSlice.test.mjs src/.../payload.test.mjs: PASS (7/7)
  • \pnpm typecheck\ & \cargo check: 0 errors
